en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a rustic, early‑20th‑century tavern or lounge. The room has dark wood wall paneling, a fireplace with a brick surround, and patterned rugs on the floor. Wooden tables and chairs are arranged around the room. The mantel and a high shelf running along the walls are crowded with beer steins, pitchers, and decorative ceramics. Several deer heads are mounted on the walls, and a large antler mount above the fireplace supports a hanging light fixture. There is handwritten numbering or labeling along the left edge of the image, consistent with archival postcard markings.
